# Matrix in table

Same formula outside a table:

$$\begin{matrix}1&2\\3&4\end{matrix}$$

Same formula inside a table:

| Value |
| --- |
| $\begin{matrix}1&2\\3&4\end{matrix}$ |

Norm command inside a table:

| Escaped double bar | Word command |
| --- | --- |
| $a\|b$ | $a\Vert b$ |
